title: fix(scripts): the read-seam census follows a moved protocol.ts body across its host split (#25467 census extension)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DXvkFFVPCoX5PE3m7xJeyn8)_

Refs #25467
Clause-②: no (PR 1 is a gate's internal recognition; PR 2 is move-only, `.d.ts` byte-identical)
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6520565826

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：读缝普查（`check-durability-degradation-log-level` 的读缝规则）现在能跟着 `protocol.ts` 拆分走：搬进 `protocol-*.ts` 模块的方法体经宿主接口调回 `protocol.ts` 的存储包装方法，仍算同一条读缝；`protocol.ts` 里调用一个"桩方法"时，也会读到它搬走的方法体。只改这一个脚本。
- 为什么改：维护者对 #25467 的裁决 B。cut 34 试搬 `deletePackage` 时普查从 93 掉到 89，掉的 4 条读缝其实还在，只是检测器看不见了，于是"搬走方法体"变成了逃出普查的路。这是检测器扩展，不是放松。
- 风险与回滚：低。只在 `packages/metadata-protocol/src` 生效，读词表、扫描根、深度上限都没变；不改任何判决、不加基线行。`main` 上读数 93 → 95，多出的 2 条是 cut 1 早就藏掉的真实读缝，判定都是"no invented answer"。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` 的 `HOST_SPLIT` 文档块与 `createHostSplit()`，以及 `isReadCall()` 里新增的两处解析。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:durability-log-level`，预期自检 65 条全过、末行 `95 read seam(s), none invents an unreported answer`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

PR 1 of 2 under ruling B on #25467: extend the read-seam census so a moved `protocol.ts` body keeps its read seams, then (PR 2, from fresh `main` after this merges) cut 35 moves `deletePackage` and the cut-33 members the census alone rejected.

`scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` only. The read-seam rule's wrapper hop (`isReadCall`) learns the two shapes the split produces, in `packages/metadata-protocol/src` and nowhere else (`HOST_SPLIT`, `createHostSplit()`):

- **Host call.** `this.x(…)` in a `protocol-*.ts` module, inside a function whose `this` parameter is the module's own host interface (bare, or `Pick` naming `x`), whose member `x` is typed as the class member `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['x']`, resolves to that class's own method `x` in `protocol.ts`. It is one hop, the same hop the call made before its body moved.
- **Stub.** A method of that class whose last statement returns `fn.call(ident, …)`, `fn` a named import from a `./protocol-*.js` module of the package that exports it, is read as `fn`'s body. That is the same method's body relocated, so it costs no depth.

Own-file resolution still wins, the read vocabulary (`find` / `findOne` / `count`), the three scan roots and `MAX_READ_WRAPPER_DEPTH` are unchanged, and the log-level rule is not touched. Every refusal leaves the hop unresolved, which is the under-counting direction the rest of the file takes. Each split file is parsed once and its index shared, so the scan and the resolver walk the same tree.

## Tests

Eight new rows in `selfTestReadSeams` (roster and floors raised 59 → 67 and 129 → 137), each a two-file fixture parsed through `createHostSplit` as the scan parses the package:

- positive: a moved body's host call into a `protocol.ts` storage wrapper is a seam; a `protocol.ts` try around a stub follows the moved body and the stub costs no hop (with the stub charged a hop the read would sit at depth 3 and drop);
- negative control from the order: a moved body whose host call reaches no storage wrapper is no seam;
- narrowness: the same files outside `packages/metadata-protocol/src`, a host member not typed as the class member, a member the `Pick` does not name: each resolves nowhere;
- bound: the host hop is a hop (a third hop through the host is refused), and the same ladder one hop deeper is a seam, so that pin is not vacuous.

`node scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, read-seam partition 65 cases (57 before), log-level partition unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **The census reading on `main` moves 93 → 95**, which the dispatch had expected to stay level; the seat accepted it in the card thread. The two new `--list` lines:
  - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-batch-data.ts:465  guards assertRecordExists()@319 in runBatchDataLoop()  → no invented answer`
  - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-batch-data.ts:756  guards assertRecordExists()@748 in runUpdateManyLoop()  → no invented answer`

  Both bodies moved out of `protocol.ts` in cut 1 (`BatchDataHost`), before cuts were screened against this census, and they reach `assertRecordExists` through the host. No verdict, no finding and no row of either baseline changes; every other `--list` line is byte-identical.
- **Positive control, the cut-34 trial tree** (the trial patch applied to `main` `bc496bf7`): the census without this change reads 89, with it 95, the same count as `main`. The four lines cut 34 lost are back: three in the moved `deletePackage` (`findEnvironmentRows`, `packagelessAddress`, `deleteMetaItem`), and `rollBackUnmanagedImport`'s guard of `deletePackage()`, through the stub. The rest of the diff is line numbers.
- **`--depth-cost`** at the shipped depth 2 reads 95 (+15 over depth 1). At depth 3 the ladder now prices 109 instead of 100, because more host hops become visible one hop out. That is the diagnostic's price list, not a shipped reading; the constant is not raised.
- `rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned`'s catch-side guard resolution (`establishesBenign`) is not extended; the ruling covers the read side. A moved body whose catch delegates to that guard is still screened out in cut 35, and that is said there.
- `skip-changeset`: a script under `scripts/`, which no package publishes.
